description: Update an existing manually-managed account. Provide at least one field to change. (Formerly `update_asset`.)

accountId.description: Id of the manual account to update.

balance.description: New current balance, as a number or a string with up to 4 decimal places.

balance_as_of.description: Date or datetime the balance is as of: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time. Ignored unless balance is also set.

closed_on.description: Date the account was closed: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time. Pass null to clear it. Closing an account that is not already closed also requires status to be closed.

currency.description: New three-letter currency code, e.g. usd. Uppercase input is lowercased.

custom_metadata.description: Optional JSON object with additional data about the account. Pass null to clear it on update.

display_name.description: New display name. Must be unique.

exclude_from_transactions.description: If true, transactions cannot be assigned to this account.

external_id.description: User-defined ID for the account (max 75 characters). Pass null to clear it.

institution_name.description: Name of the institution holding the account. Pass null to clear it.

name.description: New name of the account. 1-45 characters.

status.description: New status. Setting closed without closed_on sets closed_on to today.

subtype.description: New subtype. Pass null to clear it.

type.description: New primary type of the manual account.

name: update_manual_account
